queries.name: q01-architecture
queries.query: What architectural decisions changed the Myrmidon control plane in the last few weeks?

queries.name: q02-incident
queries.query: What was the root cause and remediation of the most recent production incident?

queries.name: q03-deploy
queries.query: How is the Myrmidon board deployed and what is the approved release procedure?

queries.name: q04-db
queries.query: What are the important database schemas, migrations, and operational database settings?

queries.name: q05-agent-role

queries.name: q06-review
queries.query: What is the required pull request review, CI, and merge workflow?

queries.name: q07-memory
queries.query: How is agent memory stored, recalled, retained, and synchronized?

queries.name: q08-task-flow
queries.query: What is the lifecycle of a task on the Paperclip board?

queries.name: q09-external
queries.query: What rules govern external calls, credentials, and secret handling?

queries.name: q10-conventions
queries.query: What repository conventions and verification rules must engineers follow?
